docs.title: Odoo Operator
docs.text:
The Odoo Operator runs Odoo on Kubernetes. You describe an instance in one OdooDeployment, and the operator does the rest:

  • it creates or adopts the PostgreSQL database;
  • it installs the modules you list, in a Job, before Odoo starts;
  • it renders odoo.conf from the spec;
  • it runs the Deployment, Services and filestore volume;
  • it upgrades the database when the image changes, or when you ask it to;
  • it serves a maintenance page while Odoo is installed, upgraded or started;
  • it backs up the database and filestore to S3, SFTP, NFS or a volume, and restores them in place, with an undo.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
kubectl apply -f https://github.com/MohanadAbugharbia/odoo-operator/releases/latest/download/install.yaml

Then start from the sample OdooDeployment.

docs.title: Writing the docs
docs.text: The site is built with MkDocs and Material for MkDocs from the docs/ folder, and published to GitHub Pages. A change in behaviour and the change to its page go in the same pull request.

docs.title: Build and preview locally
docs.text:
make docs-serve    # http://127.0.0.1:8000, reloads on every save
make docs-build    # what CI runs: fails on any warning, such as a broken link

Both create a Python virtual environment under bin/docs-venv from docs/requirements.txt on first use.

docs.title: Generated pages
docs.text:
docs/reference/api.md and docs/reference/metrics.md are generated; do not edit them. After changing a type in api/v1 or a metric in internal/metrics, run:

make docs-reference

and commit the result. CI fails a pull request whose generated pages are stale.

  • The API reference comes from the Go types and their comments, through crd-ref-docs (hack/docs/crd-ref-docs.yaml).
  • The metrics reference comes from the metrics the operator registers (metrics.Reference, written out by hack/docs). A new metric must be added to the registered list in internal/metrics/metrics.go, or to the Collector, to be exported at all, so it cannot be left out of the page.

docs.title: Preview a pull request
docs.text:
Add the docs-preview label to a pull request. The site of that pull request is then published at https://odoo-operator.abugharbia.com/pr-preview/pr-<number>/, a comment on the pull request links to it, and every push updates it. Removing the label or closing the pull request deletes the preview.

Pull requests from forks get no preview: their workflows cannot write to the repository. Every pull request, labelled or not, still builds the site.

docs.text:

docs.text:
Underlying type: string

BackupConsistency is how a backup keeps the database and the filestore in step.

Validation: - Enum: [Online Offline]

Appears in: - OdooBackupConfig

Field Description Online BackupConsistencyOnline backs up while Odoo keeps serving: the dump andthe list of files come from one database snapshot, and files deletedmeanwhile are taken from the previous backup. Offline BackupConsistencyOffline stops Odoo for the backup.

BackupStoreFormat is how backups are kept in a store.

docs.title: DatabaseCreatePolicy
docs.text:
Underlying type: string

DatabaseCreatePolicy tells the operator what to do when the database named in spec.database does not exist.

Validation: - Enum: [IfNotExists Never]

Appears in: - OdooDatabaseConfig

Field Description IfNotExists DatabaseCreatePolicyIfNotExists creates the database when it is missing andadopts it as an external database when it already exists. Never DatabaseCreatePolicyNever never creates a database; a missing database is reported as Degraded.

docs.title: DeletionPolicy
docs.text:
Underlying type: string

DeletionPolicy tells the operator what to do with an owned resource when the OdooDeployment is deleted.

Validation: - Enum: [Retain Delete]

Appears in: - OdooDatabaseConfig - PersistentVolumeClaimSpec

Field Description Retain Delete

Attempts counts the Jobs that<br />ran it.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>attempts</code> <em>integer</em></td> <td></td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>liveChanged</code> <em>boolean</em></td> <td>LiveChanged is true once the restore may have renamed the live<br />database or files; from then on it is finished by retrying, never<br />abandoned.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>retryAfter</code> <em><a href="https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#time-v1-meta">Time</a></em></td> <td>RetryAfter is when the next attempt (of the restore or its cleanup)<br />starts after a failed one.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>startedAt</code> <em><a href="https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#time-v1-meta">Time</a></em></td> <td></td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>completedAt</code> <em><a href="https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#time-v1-meta">Time</a></em></td> <td></td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>previous</code> <em><a href="#restoreprevious">RestorePrevious</a></em></td> <td>Previous is the data this restore replaced.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>cleanedUp</code> <em>boolean</em></td> <td>CleanedUp is true once the cleanup Job deleted what the restore left<br />behind (the replaced data once keepPrevious passed, any half-restored<br />copy, its journal). Only one Job (init, upgrade, backup, restore or cleanup) runs per instance at a time.</p> <p><em>Appears in:</em> - <a href="#odoodeploymentstatus">OdooDeploymentStatus</a></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Field</th> <th>Description</th> <th>Default</th> <th>Validation</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><code>kind</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>Kind: backup, restore or cleanup.</td> <td></td> <td>Enum: [backup restore cleanup] <br /></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>name</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>Name of the OdooBackup or OdooRestore.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>job</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>Job running it; empty while the operator is still stopping Odoo for it.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>stoppedOdoo</code> <em>boolean</em></td> <td>StoppedOdoo is true when the operation scaled Odoo to zero and must<br />bring it back.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>startedAt</code> <em><a href="https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#time-v1-meta">Time</a></em></td> <td>StartedAt is when the operation started.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h4 id="pvcstore">PVCStore<a class="headerlink" href="#pvcstore" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h4> <p>PVCStore is a PersistentVolumeClaim in the store's namespace, mounted into the backup Jobs. Optional for most S3-compatible services.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>bucket</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>Bucket holding the backups.</td> <td></td> <td>MaxLength: 63 <br />MinLength: 3 <br />Pattern: <code>^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$</code> <br /></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>path</code> <em><a href="#storepath">StorePath</a></em></td> <td>Path inside the bucket. Most S3-compatible services need it; AWS does not.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>credentialsSecret</code> <em><a href="https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#localobjectreference-v1-core">LocalObjectReference</a></em></td> <td>CredentialsSecret holds AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.</td> <td></td> <td></td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h4 id="sftpstore">SFTPStore<a class="headerlink" href="#sftpstore" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h4> <p>SFTPStore is a folder on an SSH server.</p> <p><em>Appears in:</em> - <a href="#odoobackupstorespec">OdooBackupStoreSpec</a></p> <table> <thead> <tr> <th>Field</th> <th>Description</th> <th>Default</th> <th>Validation</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td><code>host</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>Host of the SSH server.</td> <td></td> <td>MinLength: 1 <br />Pattern: <code>^[A-Za-z0-9.:\[\]-]+$</code> <br /></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>port</code> <em>integer</em></td> <td>Port of the SSH server.</td> <td>22</td> <td>Maximum: 65535 <br />Minimum: 1 <br /></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>user</code> <em>string</em></td> <td>User to log in as.</td> <td></td> <td>MinLength: 1 <br />Pattern: <code>^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$</code> <br /></td> </tr> <tr> <td><code>path</code> <em><a href="#storepath">StorePath</a></em></td> <td>Path on the server, relative to the user's home folder unless it<br />starts with "/". docs.title: Metrics
docs.text:
The manager serves these on /metrics beside the controller-runtime defaults. Series marked scrape time are read from each OdooDeployment's status when Prometheus scrapes, and only the elected leader reports them; the others are counted as events happen.

Metric Type Labels Description odoo_operator_backup_duration_seconds histogram kind How long backups that succeeded took, from the start of their first Job to completion. odoo_operator_backup_last_failed gauge namespace, name 1 when the instance's most recently finished backup failed. (scrape time) odoo_operator_backup_last_size_bytes gauge namespace, name, part Sizes of the instance's newest successful backup: part is database, filestore or added (new data uploaded). (scrape time) odoo_operator_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds gauge namespace, name When the instance's newest successful backup (Completed or CompletedWithWarnings) completed, as a Unix timestamp. (scrape time) odoo_operator_backup_missing_files gauge namespace, name Attachments the database refers to that the instance's newest successful backup could not include. (scrape time) odoo_operator_backup_store_ready gauge namespace, store 1 when the OdooBackupStore's last probe could write, read and delete a file. (scrape time) odoo_operator_backups_total counter kind, result Backups (OdooBackup) that finished, by kind (manual, scheduled, pre-upgrade) and result (succeeded, failed). odoo_operator_build_info gauge version Always 1; the version label is the running operator release. odoo_operator_database_operations_total counter operation, result Database create, adopt and drop operations, by result (succeeded, failed, refused). A failure is counted once until it clears. odoo_operator_deployment_condition gauge namespace, name, type, status, reason Always 1, one series per status condition; status is true, false or unknown. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_condition_last_transition_timestamp_seconds gauge namespace, name, type When each status condition last changed status, as a Unix timestamp. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_database_ready gauge namespace, name, provisioned_by 1 while the DatabaseReady condition is true; provisioned_by is operator or external. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_image_pending gauge namespace, name 1 while spec.image differs from status.appliedImage (an image check or upgrade is pending). (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_info gauge namespace, name, image, applied_image, database Always 1; the labels are the OdooDeployment's spec.image, status.appliedImage and database name. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_job_start_timestamp_seconds gauge namespace, name, kind When the running init or upgrade Job was created, as a Unix timestamp. Absent while no Job runs. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_last_upgrade_duration_seconds gauge namespace, name status.lastMaintenanceDuration: how long the last successful upgrade Job took. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_phase gauge namespace, name, phase 1 for the OdooDeployment's current status.phase, 0 for the others. (scrape time) odoo_operator_deployment_replicas_desired gauge namespace, name spec.replicas: Odoo pods the OdooDeployment runs outside maintenance. (scrape time) odoo_operator_image_pull_failures_total counter namespace, name Times a new image could not be pulled, counted once each time an OdooDeployment becomes Degraded with ImagePullFailed. odoo_operator_job_duration_seconds histogram kind, result How long init and upgrade Jobs that succeeded or failed took, from creation to completion or failure. odoo_operator_jobs_total counter namespace, name, kind, result Init and upgrade Jobs that finished, by result (succeeded, failed, superseded). Each Job is counted once. odoo_operator_maintenance_page_publish_errors_total counter namespace, name Failed attempts to publish an OdooDeployment's status to its maintenance page. odoo_operator_restores_total counter mode, result In-place restores (OdooRestore) that finished, by mode (restore, undo) and result (succeeded, failed).
